name: Moto Kishi Haha Sophie no Bouken Zenpen
original_name: 元騎士母ソフィーの冒険前篇
source:
Sophie who was once a knight enjoys her married life in the countryside. 
Sadly, however, her child gets diseased so she heads to a neighboring village for medicine...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE238618.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
曾经是一名骑士的苏菲在乡村享受着婚姻生活。
然而不幸的是，她的孩子生病了，所以她前往邻近的村庄寻求药物……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE238618.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
